messages:
IncidentBot: PagerDuty alert: control-plane-auth service returning 5xx spike (502/504) — 1200 errors in 3m. Paging oncall. :rotating_light:
Aisha K: seeing it in console too, spikes at ~14:02 UTC. dashboard: https://console.redwood/infr/alerts/3099999999 :eyes:
Tom B: I'm on infra-debug. Can someone confirm customer-facing errors? any 429s or only 5xx?
Jules R: customer errors are 502 from API gateway, correlating with auth upstream 504s. A few live threads reporting increased latencies.
Aisha K: initial triage — likely control plane dependency (org-lookup/auth) cascade. Rolling logs show repeated timeouts to auth-db and a surge of long-tail KV ops.
Eleni M: looks like a config rollout finished at 13:58 that changed connection pool settings on auth. Reverting now.
ops-bot: Deploy rollback initiated for deploy/config-auth-pool v2026-03-15T13:58 by Eleni M — status: in_progress
Tom B: while rollback runs, enable circuit-breaker fallback for org-lookup to cached responses to reduce pressure. Patch: PATCH /controlplane/config -> set orglookup.cache_fallback: true
Jules R: doing the fallback flip. ETA ~35s. posting curl command: ```curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/config -d '{"orglookup": {"cache_fallback": true}}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer **'```
Aisha K: enabling rate-limit on gateway for unauthenticated endpoints to protect backend: set 100 rps per IP for /v1/* routes.
Support Sally: started compiling customer impact note. Early estimate: ~5% API calls returning 502 across hosted API, spike started ~13:58 UTC, peak 14:06, some customers reported failures in ingestion jobs.
pagerduty: On-call escalation to secondary: Tom B (primary) -> Jules R (secondary) accepted.
Tom B: rollback succeeded around 14:08, config reverted to v2026-03-15T13:50. auth service connection pool restored.
ops-bot: Deploy rollback status: success — all replicas healthy.
Jules R: after rollback, 502s dropped ~80% within 60s, still seeing intermittent 504s to billing-service. Tracing shows stuck connections on billing proxy.
Aisha K: ok let's isolate: route a small percentage to fallback auth-by-token local cache path to validate. add logging for downstream latency: set env DEBUG_AUTH=true on auth-proxy for 10m.
Tom B: applied DEBUG_AUTH env on auth-proxy, streaming logs: ```[14:09:12] auth-proxy conn_id=0x7f4 timeout waiting for billing response
[14:09:13] auth-proxy conn_id=0x7f5 success after retry latency=340ms```
Eleni M: created a temporary bypass for billing calls for low-risk token checks, reducing load on billing by ~40%. Patch id: bypass-3099
Jules R: monitoring error-rate panel — control-plane 5xx now trending down to baseline but gateway 502s show residual bursts at 14:11 and 14:14. Likely some connection pool warmed slowly.
Aisha K: customer impact statement draft: "Between 13:58–14:12 UTC some API requests returned 502/504 due to an inadvertent connection-pool change in the auth config rollout. Impact: transient failures for ~5% of requests; mitigated by rollback, circuit-breaker fallback to cache, and billing bypass. No user data loss."
Support Sally: pushed customer note to status page draft: https://status.redwood/incident/3099999999 — please review before publish.
Tom B: next steps: 1) postmortem runbook assigned to Jules (owner), 2) add pre-deploy gate for auth connection-pool changes, 3) increase canary duration for config-rollouts touching control-plane.
Jules R: owning postmortem, will include timeline, deploy diff, and follow-ups. Creating doc: /wiki/incidents/3099999999-postmortem (will link here when created).
Aisha K: handing off monitoring to Eleni for the night — I'll be offline in 25m. Eleni pls ack.
Eleni M: ack, I'll monitor for 2h and escalate if error-rate >1% sustained.
Tom B: also adding a short-term telemetry alert: if control-plane auth 5xx > 0.5% for 5m trigger paging.
ops-bot: Reminder: runbook link for auth issues: https://runbooks.redwood/auth-5xx — posted to channel.
Support Sally: published status page: "Mitigated — root cause suspected config rollout; rollback applied; monitoring." Customers informed via email template: "We experienced transient 5xx errors..."
Jules R: quick note to triage team: collect pprof of auth-proxy containers from 13:55–14:10, capture connection pool metrics, and save for postmortem.
Aisha K: thanks all. If anything flares, ping pagerduty. Closing thread for active mitigation but keeping incident open for postmortem tasks. :white_check_mark:
